page.layout: One printed page, text block in the centre-right; a narrow marginal note column at the left of the text block near the lower half. Running head at the top with page number at top left. main_text.l: vincitur, ubi testes inducuntur ex Seculo Nono S.

tus Holkot.

Clemangis, Episcopus Chemensis author libri de Onere

LXX. Adeò frequens paulò ante Reformationem Cleri
scortatio & concubinatus fuit, ut in ludum & jocum
abiverit, quod ex quodlibetari disputatione Heidel­
bergæ solenniter ventilata probatur.
LXXI. Hierarchiam impuritate & luxuriâ carnis multis
modis se polluere, adeoque Babylonem M. esse, conclu­ditur.
I. Ad habitum interiorem Babylonis Magnæ Spiri­tus
S. haud obscurè luxuriam & impuritatem
carnis refert. Nam & Meretricem, neque qua­
lemcunque, sed μεγάλω Magnam Apoc.xvi.r.
utramque propter scortationem spiritualem &
corporalem, eámque

marginalia.note: Ad habi­tum interio­rem Baby­lonis M. per­tinet etiam luxuria & impuritas carnis.

page.notes: Woodcut initial "A" at the start of the paragraph beginning "Ad habitum". Greek phrase "μεγάλω" is as far as legible; the word after "Magnam" in the Greek is uncertain. Marginal note at left transcribed as printed. Page-foot watermark "Digitized by Google" omitted.
